items.title: The >70% rule and the -250 floor only overlap between 70.0% and 71.4%
items.detail: A price of -250 is a decimal 1.40, i.e. an implied 71.4%. Any selection the model rates above 71.4% is priced shorter than the brief's short end and therefore falls outside -250 to +10,000. The two conditions can only be met together inside a 1.4-point probability band. The desk applies both literally: High requires >=70.0% AND a fair price inside the window. Selections above the band are graded Medium and named below rather than relabelled.

items.title: The live OLBG listings disagree with the governing bodies on more than 20 fixtures
items.detail: Read on 22 October 2026, OLBG's sport hubs carried pairings or round labels the official source contradicts: four Top 14 pairings that are not the LNR's J7 card; a Hilux NPC 'Bay of Plenty v Wellington' final when NZR's final is Canterbury v Northland on 26 October; NBL 'Melbourne v Sydney' and 'Adelaide v Brisbane' when the NBL schedule has Illawarra v Sydney and Perth v Melbourne; MLB Dodgers v Mets and Yankees v Guardians when the World Series is Dodgers v Blue Jays; an 'England Women v India Women' ODI on a date the ECB does not have one; a South Africa v Australia '3rd ODI' on a day CSA lists the 2nd Test. Those OLBG rows are excluded from this desk rather than priced.

items.title: Model constants are disclosed, not fitted
items.detail: Goal, point and game margins are normal with sport-specific sigma (7.0 goals handball, 13.0 points basketball, 5.5 games tennis) and the margin mean is a linear function of the verified differentials. No constant was fitted to a market price. A different sigma moves every alternate line, so the prices should be read as our own opinion, not as a market forecast.
items: See the Method page for the exact equations
